user_approval.approval_statement: The identified Phase 5A claim set is approved as the sole valid claim boundary for the subsequent manuscript revision and reviewer response. Phase 5B is authorized.

global_prohibited_assertions: The study proves causal determinants of employee performance.
Retained features were verified as available before a real evaluation decision.
The evidence establishes prospective or deployment validity.
A universally best model or information policy was identified.
SHAP values identify causal, actionable, or employee-level prescriptions.
The subgroup analysis proves fairness or discrimination.
Department reconstructability proves department use by the performance model.
HRDataset_v14 is a locked-model external validation of the INX system.
The two target mappings or organizational ratings are construct-equivalent.
The literature review establishes a world-first or exhaustive novelty claim.
Public source presence proves source authenticity or redistribution rights.
Raw employee-level data are approved for public redistribution.
Ethics approval, exemption, consent waiver, funding, conflicts, or author roles are resolved.
The repository is open source despite the absence of a software license.
A final tag, GitHub release, archival record, or DOI already exists.

claims.proposed_claim: The INX analysis is a cross-sectional sensitivity study under explicit feature-availability assumptions, not an observed prospective prediction exercise.
claims.evidence_scope: Declared scenario and feature-availability contract for the INX cross-sectional table.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Feature and decision timestamps are unobserved, and prospective availability is not verified.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not describe any policy as leakage-free, prospective validation, or deployment evidence.

claims.proposed_claim: The benchmark identifies metric-specific leaders rather than one universally superior model.
claims.evidence_anchor: They do not establish prospective validity, causality, fairness, deployment readiness, or a universally best model.
claims.evidence_scope: Nine systems evaluated on common exactly-once out-of-fold INX predictions.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Leadership is conditional on the metric, P3 feature policy, and frozen cross-validation protocol.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not name any system as universally best or deployment-ready.

claims.proposed_claim: The five-repetition ranges describe training and split variability and are not confidence intervals.
claims.evidence_anchor: The reported minimum–maximum ranges are empirical repetition ranges, not confidence intervals
claims.evidence_scope: Five prespecified repeated 5×5 nested-cross-validation designs.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The summaries reflect only the five fixed repetition identities and their shared sample.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not present empirical repetition ranges as sampling confidence intervals.

claims.proposed_claim: Fixed-schedule and independently retuned policy contrasts answer different descriptive questions and neither estimates a causal feature-policy effect.
claims.evidence_anchor: Neither is a causal feature or retuning effect.
claims.evidence_scope: Matched fixed-schedule and policy-specific retuned P0–P5 estimands.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Retuned contrasts combine information access with policy-specific model selection.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not interpret policy differences as causal feature effects or real deployment performance.

claims.proposed_claim: SHAP stability and deletion behavior characterize the fitted model under the declared aggregation and masking interventions, not causal employee-level effects.
claims.evidence_anchor: Model attribution is not a causal feature effect
claims.evidence_scope: Exact-fold grouped TreeSHAP rankings and model-level median/mode deletion diagnostics.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Masking can create out-of-distribution hybrid records, and comparison pairs are not independent.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer causality, actionability, human usefulness, or employee advice from SHAP.

claims.proposed_claim: Cross-fitted sigmoid calibration improved several probability-quality point estimates but worsened top-label ECE, so calibration conclusions remain metric-specific.
claims.evidence_scope: Predeclared training-only sigmoid versus raw exactly-once out-of-fold probabilities.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: New diagnostic differences lack intervals, and ECE depends on fixed binning and support.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim that calibration improved every metric or proves future calibration.

claims.proposed_claim: Department reconstructability and JobRole-dependent performance-model outputs are separate proxy-risk diagnostics and do not establish discrimination or fairness.
claims.evidence_anchor: It does not prove that the performance model used department.
claims.evidence_scope: Support-aware subgroup grid, paired refit comparison, perturbation sensitivity, and proxy reconstruction.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: All diagnostics condition on this sample, fitted models, support rules, folds, and perturbations.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim fairness certification, discrimination, causal proxy effects, or legal compliance.

claims.proposed_claim: HRDataset_v14 provides an independently trained mapped-target protocol replication rather than locked-model external validation.
claims.evidence_anchor: It is not external validation of a locked INX model
claims.evidence_scope: Separately tuned and fitted XGBoost systems on 311 HRDataset_v14 records.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Feature space, target semantics, parameters, and sample population differ from INX.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not call this locked transport, target equivalence, or unqualified external validation.

claims.proposed_claim: The targets are recorded organizational ratings; available documentation does not validate them as objective capability, productivity, or future potential.
claims.evidence_anchor: does not establish either target as true employee capability
claims.evidence_scope: Aggregate audit of the two canonical core datasets and their documented target fields.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The audit applies only to declared rules and does not establish construct validity.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not relabel organizational ratings as objective employee performance or capability.

claims.proposed_claim: Within the frozen 25-work source-verified positioning set, no selected work reports the complete shared evidence contract used here.
claims.evidence_anchor: Within this 25-work, source-verified positioning set, no selected work reports the complete shared evidence contract used here.
claims.evidence_scope: Bounded comparison across the 25 selected, source-verified works and coded evidence fields.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The statement is bounded to the frozen set and does not cover unobserved publications.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not state world first, first ever, exhaustive review, or universal novelty.

claims.proposed_claim: No raw dataset is currently approved for redistribution; public materials must remain limited to authorized compact evidence, hashes, schemas, and qualified upstream locators.
claims.evidence_scope: Four-dataset provenance, licence, citation, and redistribution register.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Each dataset retains its distinct unresolved source-to-byte and rights-chain status.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer authenticity, ownership, unrestricted licensing, or redistribution rights from public presence.

claims.proposed_claim: Institutional review and informed-consent wording remain pending an institution-approved determination and may not be inferred from synthetic-data descriptions alone.
claims.evidence_scope: Eight-field author, ethics, availability, conflict, and AI-use declaration register.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Institution, review unit, determination, reference, date, and consent wording remain missing.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not invent ethics approval, exemption, waiver, or not-applicable wording.

claims.proposed_claim: The final v3 claim set requires an explicit digest-specific user decision before any manuscript or bibliography edit is authorized.
claims.evidence_anchor: The final v3 claim matrix is not frozen/approved
claims.evidence_scope: Open manuscript blocker carried forward from Phase 4B.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: A generic instruction to continue does not identify or approve the frozen digest.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not edit the manuscript, bibliography, or reviewer response before explicit approval.

claims.proposed_claim: Cumulative-threshold XGBoost achieved the highest full-OOF macro-F1, 0.6255.
claims.evidence_scope: Full exactly-once OOF INX sample under the frozen P3 protocol.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Highest applies only to macro-F1 among the nine evaluated systems.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not generalize this ranking to every metric or future population.

claims.proposed_claim: Cumulative-threshold XGBoost achieved the highest full-OOF balanced accuracy, 0.6745.
claims.evidence_scope: Full exactly-once OOF INX sample under the frozen P3 protocol.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Highest applies only to balanced accuracy among the nine evaluated systems.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim universal or statistically significant superiority.

claims.proposed_claim: Random Forest had the highest full-OOF quadratic weighted kappa, 0.6317.
claims.evidence_scope: Full exactly-once OOF INX sample under the frozen P3 protocol.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The ordering criterion is QWK, not macro-F1 or probability quality.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not call Random Forest the universally best model.

claims.proposed_claim: Random Forest had the lowest full-OOF ordinal MAE, 0.1583.
claims.evidence_scope: Full exactly-once OOF INX sample under the frozen P3 protocol.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Lower is better, and this result does not determine other metric rankings.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not equate low ordinal MAE with complete error safety.

claims.proposed_claim: LightGBM had the lowest normalized ranked probability score, 0.0804.
claims.evidence_scope: Raw full-OOF probabilities from nine systems under the P3 protocol.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Lower is better and the claim applies to normalized RPS only.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer overall model superiority from one probability metric.

claims.proposed_claim: Nominal XGBoost had the lowest raw log loss, 0.5515.
claims.evidence_scope: Raw full-OOF probabilities from nine systems under the P3 protocol.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Lower is better and the comparison precedes the predeclared sigmoid evaluation.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not present raw log-loss leadership as universal superiority.

claims.proposed_claim: Across five repeated nested-CV designs, XGBoost mean macro-F1 was 0.6288.
claims.evidence_scope: Mean over five prespecified 5×5 nested-CV repetitions.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The mean is descriptive across five repetitions and is not a confidence estimate.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim stable universal leadership or population-level certainty.

claims.proposed_claim: Across five repeated nested-CV designs, LightGBM mean macro-F1 was 0.6249.
claims.evidence_scope: Mean over five prespecified 5×5 nested-CV repetitions.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: LightGBM and XGBoost split repetition-level macro-F1 wins.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer a significant difference from the two descriptive means.

claims.proposed_claim: Random Forest ranked first for QWK in 5 of 5 repetitions.
claims.evidence_scope: Winner count over five prespecified nested-CV repetitions.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The stable winner statement applies only to QWK under this design.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer universal superiority or prospective stability.

claims.proposed_claim: Cumulative-threshold XGBoost ranked first for balanced accuracy in 4 of 5 repetitions.
claims.evidence_scope: Winner count over five prespecified nested-CV repetitions.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: One repetition was won by another model and no inferential test is attached.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not describe the ordering as invariant or statistically proven.

claims.proposed_claim: Mean pairwise macro-F1 rank Spearman correlation across repetition pairs was 0.926.
claims.evidence_scope: Ten pairwise rank comparisons across five repetitions and six tuned models.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Correlations are descriptive and repetition pairs are not independent samples.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not label the ordering perfectly stable or confidence-bounded.

claims.proposed_claim: For P2, independent retuning changed macro-F1 by +0.0185 relative to the fixed schedule.
claims.evidence_scope: Full-OOF retuned-minus-fixed point difference for the P2 policy.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: This point difference has no confidence interval and combines policy-specific selection with access.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not call the difference causal, significant, or deployment-valid.

claims.proposed_claim: For P5, independent retuning changed QWK by -0.0344 despite improving some other metrics.
claims.evidence_scope: Full-OOF retuned-minus-fixed point difference for the P5 policy.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: P5 removes declared strong proxies but cannot prove absence of residual proxies.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim monotonic benefit, fairness proof, or causal proxy removal.

claims.proposed_claim: The retuned P0 information-rich diagnostic reached macro-F1 0.8943.
claims.evidence_scope: Retuned P0 full-OOF point estimate with outcome-proximal/timing-risk fields retained.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: P0 is a diagnostic upper bound and is explicitly never deployable.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not present P0 as prospective performance or an admissible HR policy.

claims.proposed_claim: The mean top-5 Jaccard agreement across model-seed pairs was 1.0000.
claims.evidence_scope: Fifteen pairwise comparisons across fixed model seeds.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Pairs share data and protocol components and are not independent observations.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not call SHAP perfectly robust, causal, or confidence-bounded.

claims.proposed_claim: Mean all-feature Spearman agreement across outer-training resample pairs was 0.9847.
claims.evidence_scope: Ten pairwise comparisons among five stratified 80% outer-training resamples.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The same Spearman summary is repeated across top-k rows and is descriptive.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer sampling independence or explanation validity from rank agreement alone.

claims.proposed_claim: Deleting the top-ranked feature produced a mean probability-drop contrast of 0.2676 versus random deletion.
claims.evidence_scope: SHAP-guided minus 20 random-repetition mean deletion contrast.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The contrast is descriptive and median/mode masking can be out of distribution.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not interpret the perturbation as a causal or actionable employee effect.

claims.proposed_claim: Cross-fitted sigmoid calibration reduced log loss to 0.4556.
claims.evidence_scope: Predeclared outer-training-only sigmoid probabilities on 1,200 exactly-once OOF cases.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The method was predeclared and outer-test outcomes were evaluation-only.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim prospective calibration or objective outcome probabilities.

claims.proposed_claim: Top-label ECE changed by +0.0044 after sigmoid calibration, indicating a worse point estimate on that metric.
claims.evidence_scope: Sigmoid-minus-raw top-label ECE difference using ten fixed bins.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The paired interval spans zero and ECE is bin-dependent.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not state that every calibration metric improved.

claims.proposed_claim: Removing JobRole and refitting changed the argmax prediction for 10.75% of cases.
claims.evidence_scope: Exact paired OOF comparison of P3 and P3 refitted without JobRole.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The comparison combines feature removal with refitting and is not the broader P5 policy.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not describe the change rate as a causal JobRole effect.

claims.proposed_claim: The proxy-reduced-minus-primary macro-F1 difference was -0.0330.
claims.evidence_scope: Exact paired OOF P3-minus-JobRole refit comparison on 1,200 cases.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The point difference is descriptive and combines removal with model refitting.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer discrimination, causality, or significance.

claims.proposed_claim: Marginal within-fold JobRole permutation produced mean total variation 0.1024.
claims.evidence_scope: Mean over 20 prespecified outcome-blind marginal shuffles.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Marginal shuffling can create out-of-distribution feature combinations.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not treat the perturbation as a causal or inferential effect.

claims.proposed_claim: Department-conditional within-fold JobRole permutation produced mean total variation 0.0529.
claims.evidence_scope: Mean over 20 prespecified outcome-blind department-conditional shuffles.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Conditioning only on department is not a fully conditional permutation test.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not call the difference a causal JobRole contribution.

claims.proposed_claim: Department reconstruction accuracy with JobRole in the feature space was 0.9792.
claims.evidence_scope: Separate nominal multiclass proxy reconstruction diagnostic.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: This measures information in the feature space, not use by the performance model.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer discrimination, causality, or performance-model dependence.

claims.proposed_claim: Department reconstruction accuracy without JobRole was 0.2908.
claims.evidence_scope: Separate nominal multiclass proxy reconstruction diagnostic without JobRole.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: This is a proxy-risk contrast, not a fairness or causal test.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer absence of residual department information or legal compliance.

claims.proposed_claim: Under the retained three-class HRDataset_v14 mapping, raw XGBoost mean macro-F1 was 0.6531.
claims.evidence_scope: Mean across five prespecified 5×5 nested-CV repetitions on 311 records.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The value is mapping- and dataset-specific and the repetition range is not a confidence interval.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not call the result locked external validation or direct INX comparability.

claims.proposed_claim: Under the retained three-class mapping, sigmoid-calibrated XGBoost mean QWK was 0.6044.
claims.evidence_scope: Mean across five prespecified 5×5 nested-CV repetitions on 311 records.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Sigmoid calibration lowered macro-F1 even while improving this ordinal criterion.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim that calibration uniformly improved HRDataset_v14 performance.

claims.proposed_claim: The retained mapped HRDataset_v14 class 2 contains 31 records.
claims.evidence_scope: Governed three-class target mapping combining PIP and Needs Improvement.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The mapping is a study estimand and does not establish equivalence with INX labels.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not treat mapped classes as validated construct-equivalent outcomes.

claims.proposed_claim: The audited INX table contains 1200 rows.
claims.evidence_scope: Exact pinned INX raw-table dimensions in the aggregate quality audit.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Row count does not establish representativeness, authenticity, or licensing.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer population coverage or source authority from table size.

claims.proposed_claim: HRDataset_v14 contains 215 effective missing cells under the declared audit rule.
claims.evidence_scope: Whitespace-aware aggregate missingness audit on the pinned 311×36 raw table.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Most missing termination dates are structurally aligned with non-terminated records.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not state that all missingness is error or silently impute source values.

claims.proposed_claim: A total of 3 declared HRDataset_v14 data-quality rules had findings.
claims.evidence_scope: Twenty-nine predeclared HRDataset_v14 audit rules.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: The count applies to declared rules and is not a complete error census.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim the dataset is otherwise error-free or invalid.

claims.proposed_claim: Those three HRDataset_v14 rules account for 6 recorded anomaly occurrences.
claims.evidence_scope: Two occurrences in each of three declared consistency/temporal rules.
claims.mandatory_qualifier: Occurrences can concern distinct rules and were retained without silent source repair.
claims.prohibited_overclaim: Do not imply six unique erroneous employees without row-level overlap analysis.
